node.acceptance_condition: Returns a three-part write-up labeled (a) strongest plain form, (b) honest concession, (c) surviving rebuttal, in essay-register prose, addressing why the sincerity requirement does and does not apply and how the non-sentimental range of AI output supports the thesis.
node.expected_contribution: A finished, reusable steelman block on the sincerity/category-misfit objection (plus the non-formulaic range) with its concession and rebuttal, ready for synthesis.
node.objective: Develop the counterargument that kitsch requires sincerity that AI can only simulate, so the category itself misfits AI art — folding in the supporting point that much AI output is not sentimental or formulaic. Produce (a) its strongest plain-language form, (b) the honest concession, and (c) the rebuttal that remains available to the thesis.
node.rationale: This is the third independent strong objection, revolving on the definitional boundary of kitsch (sentimentality, formula, sincerity) and the observable range of AI output. It is analytically separate from the gatekeeping and intention threads.
